searchText: On CALL action if execution reverts, should delegated account stay as warm loaded (target account stays warm)? Would assume yes. And would need one clarification, if tx to is pointing to eip7702 bytecode do we charge additional gas for delegated bytecode load? it should follow the same behavior as CALL does today for a normal target, which i assume is keep it warm i'm inclined to leave it as-is and just consider it paid for out of the general 21000 cost of originating the transaction Awesome, thanks
